title: Build the scalar minimality route
statement: Build a semantics-backed bounded minimality route for a tiny A0 scalar language before adding scoped RV64 and x86-64 counterparts.

evidence.note: The exhaustive width-eight route fulfills the first tiny-language A0 minimality obligation. It does not establish arbitrary-program, arbitrary-width, RV64I, or x86-64 minimality.
